project: CSCI 544 Group 36: Regulation-Grounded Triage and Response Drafting for CFPB Consumer Complaints

data.labels: silver gold labels from adjudicated LLM annotation (annotation/ANNOTATION_GUIDE.md)

caveats: Generator changed: the frozen Nemotron model was retired on 2026-10-03; all final drafts use nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b-a12b. Midterm pilot numbers are not comparable.
Checker set 2 labels are AI-adjudicated and not human-validated.
T was tuned on checker set 1 (drafts from the retired model); set 2 is the transfer test.
Report-half samples are small (65 in-scope retrieval items, 91 for H5, 100 checker pairs); most differences between strong systems are within noise.

H1_retrieval.alpha: tuned on the dev half by MRR

best_retriever.name: hybrid_mpnet
best_retriever.rule: report-half hit@5 with FCRA, ties by MRR (docs/tasks/ishani.md)
best_retriever.note: picked on the numbers it is reported on, so its lead is optimistic; hybrid mpnet minus dense mpnet hit@5 +0.046 [-0.031, +0.123] (docs/tasks/results/ishani_supplement/h1_supplement.json)

verdict.hypothesis: Dense or hybrid retrieval puts the gold section in the top 5 more often than BM25.
verdict.detail: with FCRA, all 6 dense/hybrid hit@5 gains over BM25 have CIs above 0; best hybrid_mpnet hit@5 0.6615 vs BM25 0.2462

H2_H3_attribution.generator: nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b-a12b (the frozen nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b was retired by NVIDIA on 2026-10-03); temperature 0, prompt v1-9d0f038c, k = 5

H2.hypothesis: Drafts from the oracle section are more often supported and about the right section than drafts from retrieved passages.
H2.detail: gap in supported-and-gold-section positive with CI above 0 for both retrievers at both cutoffs; partly by construction (oracle passages are all gold-section)

H3.hypothesis: Even with the oracle section, a measurable share of sentences is unsupported.
H3.detail: share depends strongly on the cutoff; no CI on the share itself

set1.note: T was chosen on set 1, so NLI@T here is optimistic

set2.held_out: no sentence shared with set 1; 50 BM25-retrieved and 50 oracle pairs
set2.labels: AI-adjudicated (Claude worksheet), not human-validated; accepted by Atharva
set2.note: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash returned HTTP 410 (retired) for set 2

verdict.hypothesis: The NLI checker agrees with the reference labels well enough to flag unsupported sentences; if not, an LLM judge does better.
verdict.detail: held-out set 2: NLI@T balanced accuracy 0.679, catches 74.5% of unsupported sentences; the LLM judge is not better (difference CI includes 0). Moderate agreement, not reliable enough to replace review: the checker is a screening aid.

exploratory_rechecks.status: post hoc, after seeing report-half results (docs/tasks/results/gagan.md Secs. 4-7)

verdict.hypothesis: Retrieval confidence flags complaints no regulation covers, better than the BM25 top score (AUROC 0.43).
verdict.detail: logistic regression AUROC 0.7402 [0.6254, 0.8509], CI above 0.5 and 0.43; but 1.27 wrong referrals per correct one, so useful as a prompt, not for automatic abstention

chunking.finding: structure-aware struct1400 beats fixed 200-word windows for dense and hybrid (CIs below 0); whole sections are indistinguishable for hybrid

fcra_distraction.population: gold_regulation not in {NONE, FCRA} and dev_half == False
fcra_distraction.finding: adding FCRA chunks lowers dense and hybrid hit@5 on non-FCRA complaints

post_h1_retrieval.note: post-H1 experiments; H1 stands as reported. Settings chosen by dev-half MRR only.
post_h1_retrieval.split: report half (metrics.half == 1), in-scope complaints, with FCRA

regulation_prior.what: H1 hybrid + 0.3 for chunks of the classifier's regulation (dev choice; cross-encoder rerankers ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2 and bge-reranker-base did not beat it on dev)

llm_rerank.what: the above, then nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b (think32k) picks 5 sections from the top 10

caveats: The first LLM-rerank run returned no answer on 327 of 381 calls (reasoning budget 8192 tokens); its report-half numbers were printed before the fix. The fix addressed only the empty answers, and every choice stayed on the dev half.

final_accuracy_clusters.definition: share of drafted sentences that the checker supports AND that cite the gold section or a frozen cluster member

clusters.label_status: silver (LLM-built, LLM-reviewed); no human review by decision of Aditya, 2026-11-19

final_accuracy_clusters.disclosure: metric designed after the strict results were seen; strict score reported beside it
final_accuracy_clusters.selection_note: full-llm_top1's context layout was chosen on the dev half; its report-half value is the unbiased one

finalized_pipeline.pipeline: Nemotron Embed 8B + BM25 + regulation prior -> GPT-5.6 Sol reranker (rubric hints, K 10) -> top1x5 context -> Nemotron Super drafter (prompt v1) -> mean(DeBERTa NLI, Ultra judge) >= 0.9737792968749999 -> gating (2 rounds, keep), flags and rewrites judged by the same checker
caveats: Gating and scoring use the same checker; a human spot-check of rewritten sentences is pending (annotation/spotcheck_rewritten_heldout.csv).
Rewriting lowers the share of drafts that address the complaint (Ultra guard).
